title: 第019章 绝杀法师境这真武之意你也配懂第020章 同为女人我能帮你的就是送你上路
slug: 九叔饲养百倍返还僵尸成旱魃
content_zh:
此时，张星野正被灰袍道人逼得连连后退。
火纹法剑上的火光，被血煞压得一阵摇晃。
张清辞在旁边摇动铜铃，符箓接连打出，拼命帮哥哥压住几道从地面钻起的血线。
苏辰目光在战场上一扫，立刻看出了阵法虚实。
“张姑娘，破阵！”
“阵眼在马麟祥尸体周围！”
话音落下，苏辰左手已经摸出两张凡阶上品【破煞符】。
这符不是用来打人。
是用来打阵。
灵力灌入符中。
苏辰手腕一甩。
嗖！嗖！
两道符光贴着地面飞出，直奔灵堂前马麟祥尸体所在的位置。
灰袍道人察觉到背后动静，猛地回头，脸色大变。
“小畜生！你敢！”
他想阻拦，却已经来不及。
破煞符落下。
轰！
轰！
两声炸响，金光在马麟祥尸体周围爆开。

破煞符专破阴煞的劲道，狠狠冲入五鬼血阵。
马麟祥尸体胸口原本源源不断涌出的血亲怨气，被当场搅碎。
周围几道粗壮血线像被火灼过，发出嘶嘶声，迅速暗淡下去。
整座阵法内流转的气血顿时一滞。
灰袍道人身体一震，脸色泛红。
正与他缠斗的张星野，立刻感觉压力轻了半截。
可阵法被破，灰袍道人眼中的怒火也彻底炸开。
“我要将你抽筋拔骨，碎尸万段！！！”
他怒吼一声，全力一剑劈出，血光大盛，硬生生逼退张星野。
铛！
张星野虎口剧震，火纹法剑被震开，脚步踉跄着连退五六步才站稳。
灰袍道人没有再管他。
他猛地转身，双眼猩红，带着杀意直扑苏辰。
那柄浸透血污的桃木剑裹着血煞，直刺苏辰心口。
张星野看清这一剑，瞳孔骤缩。
“苏兄，不可硬扛！”
“快躲开！”
喊声还没落下，他已经强提一口灵力，拼命朝这边杀来。
张清辞脸色苍白，立刻摇响铜铃，试图以铃声扰乱灰袍道人神魂。
叮铃铃！

叮铃铃！
灰袍道人满脸狰狞，袖口一抖，甩出一张黑符。
黑符在半空炸开，化作一团鬼气，凝成骷髅头，扑向张清辞面门。
张清辞不得不收铃回防，甩出镇鬼符挡住鬼气。
她这一停，灰袍道人已经杀到苏辰面前。
content_en:
At this time, Zhang Xingye was being forced back by the gray-robed Taoist.
The flames on the fire-marked magic sword swayed under the pressure of the blood evil.
Zhang Qingci was shaking a copper bell beside him, and punched out the talismans one after another, trying his best to help his brother suppress the blood lines that were rising from the ground.
Su Chen glanced across the battlefield and immediately saw the reality of the formation.
"Miss Zhang, break the formation!"
"The formation eyes are around Ma Linxiang's body!"
As he finished speaking, Su Chen already took out two high-grade mortal-level [evil-breaking talismans] with his left hand.
This talisman is not for hitting people.
It is used for fighting.
Spiritual power is poured into the talisman.
Su Chen flicked his wrist.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Two talisman lights flew out against the ground and went straight to where Ma Linxiang's body was in front of the mourning hall.
The gray-robed Taoist noticed the movement behind him, turned around suddenly, and his expression changed drastically.
"You little beast! How dare you!"
He wanted to stop it, but it was too late.
The evil-breaking talisman fell.
boom!
boom!
There were two explosions, and golden light exploded around Ma Linxiang's body.
The Evil-Breaking Talisman specializes in breaking through the Yin Evil's power and rushes into the Five Ghost Blood Formation.
The resentment of blood relatives that had been pouring out of the chest of Ma Linxiang's corpse was shattered on the spot.
Several thick lines of blood around him seemed to have been burned by fire, making a hissing sound and quickly dimming.
The energy and blood flowing throughout the formation suddenly stagnated.
The gray-robed Taoist's body trembled and his face turned red.
Zhang Xingye, who was fighting with him, immediately felt that the pressure was relieved by half.
But the formation was broken, and the anger in the gray-robed Taoist's eyes completely exploded.
"I'm going to pull out your muscles and bones and break your body into pieces!!!"
He roared angrily, slashed out with his sword with all his strength, and with a burst of blood, he forcefully forced Zhang Xingye back.
clang!
Zhang Xingye's tiger's mouth was violently shaken, and the fire-marked magic sword was shaken away. He staggered back five or six steps before he regained his balance.
The gray-robed Taoist ignored him.
He turned around suddenly, his eyes were scarlet red, and he rushed towards Su Chen with murderous intent.
The blood-soaked peach wood sword was wrapped in blood and stabbed straight into Su Chen's heart.
Zhang Xingye saw the sword clearly and his pupils shrank suddenly.
"Brother Su, don't bear it forcefully!"
"Get out of the way!"
Before the shout could stop, he had already forcefully summoned up a burst of spiritual power and tried his best to fight towards this side.
Zhang Qingci turned pale and immediately rang the bell, trying to disturb the gray-robed Taoist's soul with the sound of the bell.
Jingle bell bell!
Jingle bell bell!
The gray-robed Taoist had a ferocious face, flicked his sleeves, and threw out a black talisman.
The black talisman exploded in mid-air, turned into a ball of ghostly energy, condensed into a skull, and rushed toward Zhang Qingci's face.
Zhang Qingci had to put away the bell and retreat, throwing out the ghost-suppressing charm to block the ghost energy.
The moment she stopped, the gray-robed Taoist had already reached Su Chen.
